zh.summary: 從工作角色找出該問誰、要釐清什麼，再用中立問題與具體事件建立可追溯的需求紀錄。
objectives: 依工作責任辨識使用者、規則負責人、受影響者與維運角色。
將預設解法的提問改成可追問具體事件的訪談問題。
分開記錄供述、解釋、衝突與待確認決定。

readingGuide.goal: 依工作責任辨識使用者、規則負責人、受影響者與維運角色。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 沿用 problem.md、文字編輯器及本課合成角色表；不需要真人或真實業務資料。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 problem.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 新增角色表、三題訪談問題及一筆標明合成來源的需求候選。

sections.heading: 開始設計前，先確認誰了解問題
paragraphs: 在開始設計系統之前，先搞清楚誰真正了解問題、誰會受到影響，以及誰有權決定規則。
假設有人要求你： 「幫我們公司做一套 AI 自動收件系統。」
你可能馬上想到：做一個漂亮的網頁、加上 AI、讓它自動檢查資料。
你怎麼知道自己做的功能，真的符合公司工作的方式？Role（角色）、Stakeholder（利害關係人）與 Interview（訪談）能幫你釐清。

sections.heading: 一、先建立整張知識地圖
paragraphs: 你可以把這五個步驟想成醫師看診：先找對病人與相關人員、問症狀與病史、區分觀察和推測、釐清矛盾，再決定要做什麼檢查或處置。 這個比喻只說明調查順序，軟體需求發現仍依工作證據與決策權責進行。
軟體工程也一樣，不能只聽到「我需要 AI」，就直接開藥。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜M03-02 的需求發現流程
blocks.description: 箭頭表示需求發現的工作順序；每一步保留待確認事項，不表示訪談後已證實成效。

items.title: 1. 找對人（Who）
items.body: 誰使用、誰受影響、誰負責決定？

items.title: 2. 問對問題（Interview）
items.body: 請對方描述實際做過的事情。

items.title: 3. 整理證據（Evidence）
items.body: 區分對方說的、我們推測的與尚待驗證的。

items.title: 4. 確認規則（Decision）
items.body: 遇到矛盾，找有權責的人釐清。

items.title: 5. 形成需求（Requirement）
items.body: 寫進 problem.md，準備設計與測試。

sections.heading: 二、Role 與 Stakeholder 到底有什麼不同？
paragraphs: 角色描述工作責任；利害關係人描述與系統的影響關係。用餐廳的工作分工來看兩者的差別。

blocks.heading: 1. Role（角色）＝你負責做什麼
paragraphs: 想像一間餐廳，裡面有廚師、服務生、收銀員和店長。
廚師負責料理；服務生負責接待、送餐；收銀員負責結帳；店長負責管理與決策。
這些是「角色」，描述的是工作責任，不一定是四個不同的人。同一位員工可能中午當收銀員，晚上兼任店長。在軟體開發也是如此。

blocks.heading: 2. Stakeholder（利害關係人）＝誰受到這套系統影響
paragraphs: 假設餐廳準備建置 AI 點餐系統。廚師、服務生、店長當然受到影響，還有其他人。
顧客需要容易看懂的菜單；財務人員需要正確匯出帳目；資訊維運人員需要在系統故障時恢復服務；個資管理負責人需要確認顧客資料得到適當保護。
這些人不一定會親自操作點餐系統，但系統的好壞會影響他們。Role 描述工作責任；Stakeholder 描述與系統的影響關係。
Stakeholder 並不等於有權限讀取資料的人。是否能看、修改或下載資料，是另一個需要設計的授權問題。

sections.heading: 三、要找誰訪談？不是只問主管
paragraphs: 假設你要開發「文件收件系統」。 最常見的錯誤是：主管說要做什麼，你就直接照做。
可是主管可能不知道，第一線人員每天需要人工核對哪些資料。 這時候就應該先建立一張簡單的角色訪談表。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜角色訪談表
rows: 上一次發現缺件時，怎麼處理？
什麼情況下你會退回資料？
誰決定哪些欄位不能空白？
系統壞掉時，目前怎麼處理？
上一次補件，哪部分最難理解？

blocks.heading: 讀表與下一步
paragraphs: 注意：這五個人並不是在回答同一個問題。 你是在向每個人取得他最清楚的那部分工作知識。 這也說明了為什麼訪談不能只是發一份完全相同的問卷給所有人。

blocks.heading: 補訪與協助需求
paragraphs: 角色表也應容納少數情境與協助需求，例如鍵盤操作、低頻使用或代班交接。少數人提出的障礙不會因票數少而自動失效。記錄目前還沒有訪問的角色及問題，讓下一輪研究有方向。

sections.heading: 四、Interview：怎麼問，才不會問出自己想聽的答案？
paragraphs: 訪談用來調查現有工作怎麼發生，先理解問題，再判斷 AI 解法是否適合。

blocks.heading: 錯誤示範：誘導式提問
paragraphs: 你問收件人員： 「如果我們用 AI 自動檢查文件，你是不是就能節省很多時間？」
對方可能回答： 「對啊，應該會吧。」 但這個答案能證明 AI 真的有效嗎？
不能。 因為你已經在問題裡假設 AI 會節省時間，對方可能只是同意你的想法。

blocks.heading: 正確示範：讓對方回想具體事件
paragraphs: 你改問： 「你上一次處理文件缺漏，是怎麼發現的？」
對方回答： 「我把每個欄位看過一遍，發現缺資料，就打電話給送件人。」 你再問：
「那上次花最多時間的地方在哪裡？」 對方回答：
「其實檢查很快，最久的是打電話找人。常常對方不接電話。」 現在，你發現一件很有價值的事情： 真正的瓶頸可能不是檢查資料，而是通知與補件。
如果原本直接投入大量資源開發 AI 自動檢查，可能改善了不重要的環節，卻沒有解決主要問題。 這就是需求訪談的價值。 這是待交叉確認的線索，單次訪談尚未證實真正瓶頸。

blocks.heading: 三個實用的訪談技巧
paragraphs:
1. 問過去，不急著問未來。「上次怎麼做？」通常比「未來想要什麼？」更容易取得具體工作資訊。
2. 問過程，不只問感受。「你說很麻煩，是哪個步驟花時間？」
3. 追問例外。「一般情況我理解了，那遇到資料不完整時呢？」
當然，訪談者回憶的內容仍可能有偏差。重要流程最好再利用合成案例操作、文件或其他證據交叉確認。

sections.heading: 五、訪談得到的話，不等於已經確認的事實
paragraphs: 這裡是需求工程的另一個核心觀念。 假設收件人員告訴你： 「每次資料不齊，我都會把空白欄位圈起來。」
你應該如何整理？ 這裡分成供述、推論、需求候選與待驗證解法四層，逐層保留來源與未確認事項。 為什麼要這麼麻煩？

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜分開記錄四層資訊
blocks.description: 四層表示不同性質的資訊，不是自動成立的因果鏈；供述仍需交叉確認，解法仍需試用。

items.title: 第一層：供述（Statement）
items.body:
收件人員說，他會圈出空白欄位。

這是受訪者的說法，尚不等於我們已觀察到。

items.title: 第二層：推論（Inference）
items.body:
具體指出缺漏欄位，可能可以減少補件溝通。

這是分析者提出的解釋，尚未證實。

items.title: 第三層：需求候選（Requirement Candidate）
items.body:
送件者需要清楚知道哪些欄位要補齊。

先確認這是不是真正需要支援的工作成果。

items.title: 第四層：待驗證解法（Solution Hypothesis）
items.body:
設計缺漏清單，讓送件者試用，觀察是否能正確補齊。

需要測試，而不是直接假設這個設計有效。

blocks.heading: 四層資訊為什麼要分開？
paragraphs: 因為 AI 很容易把這四種東西混成一句話： 「經過訪談，使用者需要紅色警示欄位。」
可是實際上，受訪者只說自己會圈出空白欄位，並沒有證明紅色警示是最佳解法。 事實、推論、需求、解法，必須分開。 這個原則未來也能直接用在 AI Agent 的需求分析、資安事件調查以及研究證據整理。

sections.heading: 六、兩個人說法矛盾，怎麼處理？
paragraphs: 假設收件人員說： 「文件類型可以不用填。」
但是主管說： 「文件類型一定要填。」 如果你是工程師，該相信誰？
答案是：先不要選邊。 因為兩個人可能談的是不同的工作階段。 下圖是可能的規則解釋，必須由有決定權的人確認。

blocks.caption: 圖 3｜同一欄位在不同階段可能有不同規則
blocks.description: 以上只是可能的規則解釋，必須由有決定權的人確認。兩欄並列比較適用條件，沒有自動交接或授權關係。

items.title: 暫存草稿
items.body: 文件類型可能允許空白。

items.title: 正式交接
items.body: 文件類型可能必填。

blocks.heading: 確認情境與決定者
paragraphs: 真正應該做的是先詢問：你們分別在說哪個階段、哪種案件？ 然後查看正式規範，請具有決定責任的人確認。
若最後確認上述區別成立，系統才可以設計成： - 暫存草稿：允許文件類型空白。
- 正式交接：文件類型必須填寫。 如果規則尚未決定，就應記錄為待決事項，而不是工程師自行決定。 這也是為什麼訪談要區分「知道流程的人」與「有權決定規則的人」。

sections.heading: 七、把訪談結果變成工程師能使用的文件
paragraphs: 上一課 M03-01，我們學到 `problem.md` 是整理問題陳述的文件。 今天則要把角色、訪談證據與待確認事項補進去。
例如：

blocks.heading: problem.md
paragraphs: 以下範例以 SYN-I01 標記合成來源，將供述、推論、需求與待決事項分開。
blocks.code:
# 問題：文件缺漏造成反覆補件

## 相關角色
- 收件人員
- 複核人員
- 送件人員
- 規則負責人
- 維運人員

## 訪談來源
SYN-I01（教學用合成案例）

## 供述
收件人員表示：
發現空白欄位時，會圈出後通知送件者。

## 推論
明確告知缺漏欄位，可能減少往返溝通。

## 需求候選
送件者應能知道哪些欄位需要補齊。

## 待確認規則
文件類型是否允許在暫存階段留白？

決定者：規則負責人
狀態：尚未確認

## 待驗證解法
提供缺漏欄位清單。

驗收方式：
使用合成缺件案例進行試用，
檢查送件者能否正確找出並補齊所有缺漏。

## 下一步
1. 確認正式交接規則。
2. 製作缺件測試案例。
3. 試用並記錄結果。

blocks.heading: 如何使用與保護紀錄
paragraphs: 這份文件的價值不在於寫得多漂亮，而是讓後續開發人員知道： 哪些是已取得的資訊？哪些尚未確認？誰能決定？如何驗證？
也要記得訪談資料的保護：真人訪談應事先說明目的及記錄方式，依適用要求取得同意；原始錄音、個資與可公開的摘要應分開管理。

blocks.caption: 表 3｜範例紀錄逐欄判讀
rows: 文件缺漏造成反覆補件；相關角色為收件、複核、送件、規則負責人與維運。
SYN-I01 為教學合成案例；收件人員表示會圈出空白欄位，再通知送件者。
明確告知缺漏欄位可能減少往返溝通；送件者應能知道哪些欄位需要補齊。
文件類型是否允許在暫存階段留白？決定者為規則負責人；狀態為尚未確認。
提供缺漏欄位清單；使用合成缺件案例試用，檢查送件者能否正確找出並補齊所有缺漏。
確認正式交接規則、製作缺件測試案例、試用並記錄結果。

sections.heading: 八、這一課和整個軟體工程流程的關係
paragraphs: 把 M03 前後幾課串起來，你會看到一條很清楚的主線：

blocks.caption: 表 2｜M03 的需求發現主線
rows: 現在怎麼做？希望怎麼做？
系統究竟必須具備什麼？

blocks.heading: 讀表與下一步
paragraphs: 也就是：
問題定義 → 找對利害關係人 → 蒐集工作證據 → 整理流程 → 決定需求 → 設計系統。 這比「老闆提出一個想法 → AI 直接寫程式」多了幾個步驟，卻能減少做錯方向的風險。
而且，不是所有角色都需要訪談十幾個人。小型專案可以先找最了解關鍵流程及例外情況的人，取得初步證據，再根據尚未解決的問題補訪其他角色。

sections.heading: 九、理解檢核：換你當需求分析師
paragraphs: 情境練習｜請先作答，再檢查理解
某醫院準備導入 AI 文件整理系統。護理師說每天最麻煩的是整理資料；主管希望 AI 自動完成分類；資訊人員擔心系統故障後，資料無法恢復。 請先作答下方四題，再展開參考答案核對。此為合成教學情境，不使用病人資料或代表醫院正式規範。
這一課最重要的能力，不是背出 Stakeholder 的定義，而是面對一個模糊的開發要求，能夠找到正確的人、問出真實的工作問題，並且不把未確認的說法當成系統需求。

exercise.environment: 沿用 problem.md、文字編輯器及本課合成角色表；不需要真人或真實業務資料。
steps: 為共同案例列出五種工作責任，寫下各角色最能釐清的一個問題。
將「你希望 AI 自動處理嗎」改成收件、複核、管理者各一題中立問題，並加入具體事件追問。
用合成回答寫一列供述、推論、需求候選與待確認決定，再請同儕指出哪個仍沒有證據。
exercise.expected: problem.md 新增角色表、三題訪談問題及一筆標明合成來源的需求候選。
exercise.check: 問題不預設工具；紀錄能區分角色供述、設計者推論與確認者；沒有把猜測當成實際研究。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成標記與修訂紀錄；若誤填真人姓名或非公開例子，移除後改用代號與合成情境。

en.summary: Use work responsibilities to decide whom to ask and what to clarify, then build traceable requirements records with neutral questions and concrete events.
objectives: Identify users, rule owners, affected parties and operations roles through their responsibilities.
Replace questions that assume a solution with questions about concrete events.
Record accounts, interpretations, conflicts and pending decisions separately.

readingGuide.goal: Identify users, rule owners, affected parties and operations roles through their responsibilities.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Use problem.md, a text editor and the synthetic role table. No actual participants or business data are required.
readingGuide.route: Read the scenario and principles, compare examples, then expand problem.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A role table, three interview questions and one proposed requirement with a synthetic source in problem.md.

sections.heading: Identify Who Understands the Problem Before Designing
paragraphs: Before designing a system, establish who understands the problem, who will be affected and who has authority to decide the rules.
Suppose someone asks: “Build our company an AI document intake system.”
You might immediately imagine an attractive website with AI checking the submitted information. But how will you know whether those features fit the way the company actually works?
Roles, stakeholders and interviews help you answer that question.

sections.heading: 1. Build the Knowledge Map
paragraphs: The five-step discovery process starts with finding the right people, asking about actual work, separating evidence from interpretation, confirming rules and writing requirements into problem.md. Think of a medical consultation: identify the patient and relevant people, ask about symptoms and history, separate observations from interpretations, clarify contradictions, and then decide which examinations or actions are appropriate.

This analogy describes inquiry order; it does not make software discovery a clinical procedure. Software engineers likewise need to investigate the problem behind a request for AI before choosing a solution.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | M03-02 Requirements Discovery
blocks.description: Arrows show discovery work order. Retain unresolved issues at each step; an interview alone does not establish effectiveness.

items.title: 1. Find the right people (Who)
items.body: Who uses the system, who is affected, and who decides?

items.title: 2. Ask about work (Interview)
items.body: Ask people to describe something they actually did.

items.title: 3. Organize evidence (Evidence)
items.body: Separate reported accounts, your inferences and untested claims.

items.title: 4. Confirm rules (Decision)
items.body: Ask the accountable decision owner to clarify contradictions.

items.title: 5. Form requirements (Requirement)
items.body: Record them in problem.md for design and testing.

sections.heading: 2. How Do Roles and Stakeholders Differ?
paragraphs: A role describes work responsibility; a stakeholder relationship describes influence or impact. A restaurant example helps distinguish them.

blocks.heading: A role describes your responsibility
paragraphs: Imagine a restaurant with cooks, servers, cashiers and a manager.
Cooks prepare food. Servers welcome guests and serve meals. Cashiers handle payment. The manager manages work and makes decisions.

These roles describe responsibilities; they need not be four different people. One employee may work as a cashier at noon and act as manager in the evening. The same distinction applies in software development.

blocks.heading: A stakeholder is affected by the system
paragraphs: Suppose the restaurant plans an AI ordering system. Cooks, servers and the manager are affected, along with other people.

Customers need an understandable menu. Finance staff need accurate account exports. Operations staff need a way to recover after a failure. The person responsible for personal data needs appropriate protection of customer information.

These people may never operate the ordering interface themselves, yet the quality of the system affects them. A role describes work responsibility; stakeholder describes a relationship of influence or impact with the system.
Being a stakeholder grants no right to read data. Who may view, change or download information is a separate authorization decision.

sections.heading: 3. Whom Should You Interview?
paragraphs: For a document intake system, a common mistake is to implement whatever a supervisor requests immediately. The supervisor may not know which information front-line staff check manually each day.
Start with a simple role interview table.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Role Interview Table
rows: How did you handle the last case with missing documents?
Whether documents can be handed over
Under what circumstances would you return the documents?
Who decides which fields cannot be blank?
What do you currently do when the system fails?
Difficulties filling in and correcting submissions
What was hardest to understand during your last correction?

blocks.heading: Interpretation and next step
paragraphs: These five roles answer different questions. Obtain the part of the work knowledge each knows best. Sending everyone an identical questionnaire may miss those differences.

blocks.heading: Follow-up and Support Needs
paragraphs: Include less common situations and support needs such as keyboard operation, infrequent use and shift cover. A barrier raised by fewer people does not disappear because it gets fewer votes. Record roles and questions not yet researched to guide the next round.

sections.heading: 4. How Can You Avoid Leading Questions?
paragraphs: An interview investigates how current work happens. Its purpose is to understand the work before promoting an AI solution.

blocks.heading: A leading question
paragraphs: You ask an intake worker: “If we used AI to check documents automatically, would that save you a lot of time?”
They might answer: “Yes, probably.”
Does that establish that AI is effective? It does not. The question already assumes that AI saves time; the participant may simply be agreeing with your suggestion.

blocks.heading: Ask about a specific event
paragraphs: Instead ask: “How did you discover missing information the last time you handled an incomplete document?”
The worker replies: “I checked each field. When I found something missing, I called the submitter.”
Follow up: “Which part took the most time in that case?”
They answer: “Checking was quick. Reaching the person by phone took longest. Often they did not answer.”

The bottleneck may therefore be notification and correction. Investing heavily in automatic checking could improve a less significant step while leaving the main problem unresolved. Interviewing helps identify that possibility; one account still needs corroboration.

blocks.heading: Three useful interview techniques
paragraphs: 1. Ask about the past before imagined futures. “What did you do last time?” often yields more concrete work information than “What would you want in the future?” 2. Ask about the process as well as feelings. “When you say it was troublesome, which step took time?”

3. Ask about exceptions. “I understand the usual case. What happens when information is incomplete?” Recall can be biased. Cross-check important workflows with synthetic task demonstrations, documents or other evidence.

sections.heading: 5. Interview Accounts Need Confirmation
paragraphs: Suppose an intake worker says: “Whenever information is incomplete, I circle the blank fields.” How should you record that?
Keep four distinct layers: the statement, your inference, a requirement candidate and a solution hypothesis to test.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Four Distinct Evidence Layers
blocks.description: These are different kinds of information, not an automatic causal chain. Corroborate accounts and test proposed solutions.

items.title: Layer 1: Statement
items.body:
The intake worker says they circle blank fields.

This is a participant account, not something we have observed.

items.title: Layer 2: Inference
items.body:
Identifying specific missing fields may reduce correction discussions.

This is the analyst’s explanation and remains unconfirmed.

items.title: Layer 3: Requirement Candidate
items.body:
Submitters need to know which fields to complete.

Confirm whether this is the work outcome that needs support.

items.title: Layer 4: Solution Hypothesis
items.body:
Try a missing-field list with submitters and observe whether they complete the fields correctly.

Test the design rather than assuming it works.

blocks.heading: Why Keep These Layers Separate?
paragraphs: Why separate them? AI can easily collapse all four into: “Interviews show users need red warning fields.” Yet the worker only reported circling blank fields; this does not establish that red warnings are the best solution.
Keep facts, inferences, requirements and solutions distinct. The same discipline applies to AI agent requirements analysis, security incident investigation and research evidence records.

sections.heading: 6. What If Two Accounts Conflict?
paragraphs: An intake worker says: “Document type can be left blank.” A supervisor says: “Document type is mandatory.” Which should the engineer believe?
First clarify the context. They may be discussing different stages of work.
The diagram presents a possible distinction between saving a draft and formally handing it over. A person with decision authority must confirm whether this interpretation applies.

blocks.caption: Figure 3 | A Field May Have Different Rules at Different Stages
blocks.description: This is a possible interpretation that an authorized decision owner must confirm. The columns compare conditions; they do not imply automatic handoff or access rights.

items.title: Save draft
items.body: Document type may be allowed to remain blank.

items.title: Formal handoff
items.body: Document type may be required.

blocks.heading: Confirm Context and Decision Authority
paragraphs: Ask which stage and which kind of case each person means. Check the formal rules and ask the person responsible for deciding to confirm them.
If that distinction is confirmed, the system can allow a blank document type when saving a draft and require it for formal handoff.
If no decision has been made, record a pending issue rather than letting the engineer invent a rule. Distinguish people who know the workflow from people authorized to decide its rules.

sections.heading: 7. Turn Interview Findings into an Engineering Record
paragraphs: M03-01 introduced problem.md as the problem-statement document. Now add roles, interview evidence and unresolved questions.

The shared sample below keeps the original Chinese artifact in both language editions so that identifiers and the example file remain identical. SYN-I01 is a synthetic teaching case, not an actual participant interview.

blocks.heading: problem.md
paragraphs: SYN-I01 marks a synthetic source. The sample separates statements, inferences, requirements and pending decisions.
blocks.code:
# 問題：文件缺漏造成反覆補件

## 相關角色
- 收件人員
- 複核人員
- 送件人員
- 規則負責人
- 維運人員

## 訪談來源
SYN-I01（教學用合成案例）

## 供述
收件人員表示：
發現空白欄位時，會圈出後通知送件者。

## 推論
明確告知缺漏欄位，可能減少往返溝通。

## 需求候選
送件者應能知道哪些欄位需要補齊。

## 待確認規則
文件類型是否允許在暫存階段留白？

決定者：規則負責人
狀態：尚未確認

## 待驗證解法
提供缺漏欄位清單。

驗收方式：
使用合成缺件案例進行試用，
檢查送件者能否正確找出並補齊所有缺漏。

## 下一步
1. 確認正式交接規則。
2. 製作缺件測試案例。
3. 試用並記錄結果。

blocks.heading: Use and Protect the Record
paragraphs: The record helps developers identify the information obtained, the unresolved issues, who can decide and how to verify the proposed solution.

For actual interviews, explain the purpose and recording method in advance and obtain consent under applicable requirements. Manage raw recordings, personal information and public summaries separately.

blocks.caption: Table 3 | Interpret Every Field of the Sample
rows: Missing document information causes repeated corrections. Roles: intake staff, reviewers, submitters, rule owner and operations staff.
SYN-I01 is a synthetic teaching case. Intake staff report circling blank fields and notifying the submitter.
Clear missing-field information may reduce repeated communication. Submitters should be able to identify which fields need completion.
May document type remain blank when saving a draft? Decision owner: the rule owner. Status: unconfirmed.
Provide a missing-field list. Try it with synthetic incomplete submissions and check whether submitters identify and complete every missing field correctly.
Confirm the formal handoff rule, create missing-information test cases, try the solution and record the results.

sections.heading: 8. Connect This Lesson to the Engineering Process
paragraphs: The neighboring M03 lessons form a continuous path.

blocks.caption: Table 2 | The M03 Discovery Path
rows: Whom should we ask? What information is credible?
How does work happen now? How should it happen?

blocks.heading: Interpretation and next step
paragraphs: The path is: define the problem → identify stakeholders → collect work evidence → describe workflows → decide requirements → design the system.
These steps help reduce the risk of building in the wrong direction when a manager proposes an idea and AI begins coding immediately.

A small project need not interview many people for every role. Start with those who know the critical workflow and exceptions, obtain initial evidence, then interview additional roles to resolve remaining questions.

sections.heading: 9. Check Your Understanding
paragraphs: A hospital plans an AI document organization system. Nurses say organizing information is their greatest daily difficulty; the supervisor wants automatic classification; operations staff worry that data cannot be recovered after a system failure.
Answer the four questions in the understanding-check section before opening the reference answers. The scenario is synthetic; no patient information or actual hospital policy is involved.
The intended capability is to respond to a vague development request by finding the right people, asking about actual work and keeping unconfirmed accounts separate from system requirements.

exercise.environment: Use problem.md, a text editor and the synthetic role table. No actual participants or business data are required.
steps: List five responsibilities in the shared case and one question each role can best clarify.
Replace “Would you like AI to handle this automatically?” with one neutral question each for intake, review and management, adding follow-up questions about events.
Use a synthetic answer to record an account, inference, proposed requirement and pending decision. Ask a peer which part still lacks evidence.
exercise.expected: A role table, three interview questions and one proposed requirement with a synthetic source in problem.md.
exercise.check: Questions do not assume tools; records distinguish reported actions, designer interpretation and the confirming role, without presenting guesses as research.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic labels and revision history. Replace any actual names or nonpublic examples entered by mistake with codes and synthetic situations.

zh.prompt: 你認為誰應該被納入需求訪談？
options: 只訪談主管，因為主管有決定權
只訪談護理師，因為護理師每天操作
訪談護理師、主管、資訊人員，並依流程補充其他相關角色
rationales: 主管能提供決策觀點，仍須取得實際操作者與維運者的工作證據。
護理師了解操作，但規則決策與復原需求也需要其他角色。
納入不同責任與受影響者，再依證據缺口安排補訪。

en.prompt: Who should take part in requirements interviews?
options: Only the supervisor, because the supervisor decides
Only nurses, because they operate the system daily
Nurses, the supervisor and operations staff, adding other relevant roles as the workflow requires
rationales: The supervisor provides a decision perspective; operators and operations staff provide other work evidence.
Nurses understand use, but rules and recovery also require other roles.
Include different responsibilities and affected parties, then follow up on evidence gaps.

options: AI 幫你分類是不是比較好？
你上一次整理文件時，哪個步驟最花時間？
你為什麼沒有改善自己的效率？
rationales: 這題預設 AI 分類比較好，容易誘導同意。
具體事件與耗時步驟能支持後續追問，仍須交叉確認回憶。
帶有責備與原因假設，容易讓對方防衛，也無法還原工作過程。

en.prompt: What would you ask a nurse?
options: Would AI classification be better for you?
Which step took the most time the last time you organized documents?
Why have you not improved your own efficiency?
rationales: This assumes AI classification is better and can lead the response.
A concrete event and time-consuming step support follow-up; corroborate recalled accounts.
Blame and assumed causes can make people defensive and do not reconstruct the work.

zh.prompt: 主管說 AI 能節省 80% 時間，你該怎麼記錄？
options: 直接寫成已證實的成效
當成主管的主張，要求確認估算根據並設計驗證
直接將節省 80% 當成系統功能
rationales: 訪談供述沒有證明 80% 成效；需要基準、任務範圍與實測。
保留主張與來源，釐清估算基準，再用相同任務條件驗證。
成效數值需驗證，不能直接轉成已具備的系統功能。

en.prompt: How should you record a supervisor’s claim that AI saves 80% of the time?
options: Record it as a proven result
Record it as the supervisor’s claim, check the estimate’s basis and design verification
Treat saving 80% as a system feature
rationales: An account does not prove the 80% result; establish the baseline, task scope and measurements.
Retain the claim and its source, clarify the estimate’s baseline and verify comparable tasks.
A benefit figure requires verification and is not an implemented feature.

zh.prompt: 護理師說資料可以留白，主管說不可以，你會怎麼辦？
options: 讓工程師自行選擇規則
設計兩個模式，讓使用者自行決定
確認工作階段及正式規則，再由有權責者決定
rationales: 工程師不能以個人判斷取代規則決定者。
未確認規則前先做兩模式，仍把決策轉嫁給使用者。
先確認階段、案件與正式規範；尚未決定時保留待決事項。

en.prompt: What if a nurse says a field may be blank but the supervisor disagrees?
options: Let the engineer choose the rule
Build two modes and let users decide
Clarify the work stage and formal rules, then ask the accountable owner to decide
rationales: An engineer’s preference cannot replace the rule owner’s decision.
Two unconfirmed modes still transfer the unresolved decision to users.
Clarify stages, cases and formal rules; preserve a pending issue if no decision exists.
